thread:
Oliver Reed: hey all, first day here! quick map request: where should I drop (a) setup/laptop stuff, (b) API/SDK questions, (c) product/UX asks, and (d) short intros? also: how do i snooze the daily onboarding pings?

Nadia Chen: welcome Oliver! :wave: short breakdown: (a) #help-it and tag @IT Support for hardware/VPN, (b) #eng or #devx for SDKs and implementation, (c) #product for product or feature asks, (d) #introductions or #random for a quick hello.

Nadia Chen: if something is sensitive (credentials, payroll, negotiations) use DMs or #people-ops. For infra incidents use #incidents so oncall sees it.

Design Lead: for design feedback, post in #design with a short subject and Figma link. Example root message: "Design: onboarding modal — feedback by Fri" then put comments in the thread. Avoid posting long inline images without context.

Kai M.: etiquette tips: 1) replies in-thread, not new messages; 2) add a one-line summary in the root for longer threads; 3) react with :white_check_mark: or :eyes: when done. Also avoid @channel unless it's urgent or pre-approved.

Oliver Reed: nice. how do i mute the onboarding bot until i finish day 1? it's DMing me every morning.

Onboarding Bot: automated: Hi Oliver :sparkles: To pause daily tips DM me `pause` or run `/onboard snooze 3d` in any channel. To change times DM `prefs` and set `hours` (e.g., 09:00-17:00 PT). Run `/onboard help` for commands.

IT Support: if you're stuck with laptop/VPN include OS, model, and a short error snippet. Example minimal paste: 

IT Support: ```
OS: macOS 13.5
Tool: rwctl 0.9.3
Cmd: rwctl login --org=redwood
Err: unauthorized (401)
Steps: cleared token, reinstalled
```

Oliver Reed: helpful — thanks. timezone stuff: i'm CET and don't want to wake people up. any conventions?

Kai M.: we try not to send non-urgent pings after ~6pm PT. If it's async put "no-urgent" at the start of the message or schedule it. Also add your timezone to your profile so people know when to expect replies.

Nadia Chen: pro-tip: if you don't know where to post, drop a 1-line in #new-hires like "unsure where to ask about X" and someone will point you. Keeps noisy redirects to a minimum.

Oliver Reed: perfect — i'll add timezone and mute onboarding until day 2. thanks for the quick map! :thumbsup:
